title: Set & Keep Hair Spray Extreme Hold

details.description: Maximum setting power for an ultimate style? What other than a good hairspray could hold. Fine Mist for stylish and lasting hairstyle, Gatsby Hair Spray Set & Keep Extreme Hold is your perfect catch if you want a fine and long-lasting hairstyle. No visible residue is left on the hair, it is its ultimate property. Arriving grandly with its non-sticky shine effect, design your hair with a texture all according to the latest trend. Its natural and refreshing citrus scent will leave you spellbound.
details.usageInstructions:
Sculpt your desired hairstyle with Gatsby Styling Wax.
Shake the hairspray can well before use.
Hold the can at least 15-25 cms away from your hair.
Spray liberally to hold that hairstyle in place, all day long.
It has a shelf life of 3 years. Storage Instructions: Best to be stored in a cool and dry space, away from moisture.
